front.title: Post-Quantum Cryptographic Protection Profile for OPC UA Secure Conversation

abstract.t:
This document specifies a post-quantum cryptographic protection profile for the OPC Unified Architecture Secure Conversation protocol (OPC UA UASC) carried over the opc.tcp transport. The profile uses ML-KEM-768 for SecureChannel key establishment, ML-DSA for asymmetric signatures, HKDF-SHA-256 for key derivation, and AES-256-GCM for symmetric message protection. It defines the profile identifiers, nonce encoding, key schedule, authenticated-encryption inputs, certificate and public-key binding requirements, token rollover behavior, and conformance requirements.
This Internet-Draft is a proposal for Standards Track publication. Permanent OPC UA SecurityPolicy and algorithm identifiers require coordination with the OPC Foundation; the private identifiers documented here remain provisional. This document does not assign official OPC UA identifiers or claim conformance with an OPC Foundation specification.
